system.description: A deep, oppressive forest where the light barely reaches the ground. Old battlegrounds and abandoned villages lie within, and predatory creatures stalk the shadows.
system.notes:
Mythic | Exploration

A deep, oppressive forest where the light barely reaches the ground. Old battlegrounds and abandoned villages lie within, and predatory creatures stalk the shadows.
Impulses: Harass intruders, drive them off the paths, kill and feed

Difficulty: 16

Features

Omens of Danger - Passive: The forest feels wrong, completely devoid of birdsong and wind. When a PC takes time to search for signs of danger, they can make an Instinct or Wits Roll.

  • Success: Learn three Detais.
  • Success with Fear: Learn two Details.
  • Any Failure: Mark a Stress to learn a Detail and gain Advantage on the next roll within this environment.

Details: Broken branches and claw marks on trees suggest something large has been hunting here. A mass grave or battlefield lies nearby, attracting scavengers and worse. Strange tracks (humanoid, but twisted) lead toward a cave or abandoned ruin deeper in the woods.

Closing Paths - Action: Hidden watchers or triggered deadfalls block the route behind the PCs. They must make a Progress Countdown (4) to find another way through before being boxed in. On a failure, they encounter hostile creatures or trigger a trap.

Ghostly Onslaught - Action: Spend a Fear to unleash a surge of spectral energy as shapes of long-dead soldiers and villagers lash out from the trees. All PCs within Very Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they take 2d10 direct magic damage as the phantoms tear at their spirit and resolve.

Unseen Stalker - Reaction: Countdown (Loop 6). When the PCs enter the forest, activate the countdown. When it triggers, they are ambushed by a powerful predator. Spotlight them immediately.
